description: This pie chart, titled “Distribution of data source in the combined training set,” visually represents the proportional contribution of ten distinct data sources to a combined training set. The chart is divided into ten slices, each labeled with its corresponding source name and percentage value. The largest segment is labeled “NQ” at 31.3%, shown in a dark blue color. Following this, “FEVER” accounts for 16.1% in a teal-green shade. “MULTINLI” contributes 11.3% in a reddish-brown hue. “SNLI” makes up 15.4% in a tan color. “VITAMINC” is 13.0% in a medium teal. “XSUMHUL” is 1.6% in a light blue-gray. The smallest segments are “SCIFACT” at 0.1% (light yellow-green), “ENTFA” at 1.8% (light green), “FACTCC” at 2.6% (orange-brown), and “ANLI” at 4.6% (dark green). Each slice is clearly labeled with its percentage and connected by a line to its respective category name. The chart does not include a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized or exploded; the segments appear arranged in descending order of size, starting from the largest at the top right and proceeding clockwise.
